archetypes.name: stateflow
archetypes.rationale: Diff rewires /design Step 3/3.5 into a multi-round state machine with many terminal and resume paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the /design Step 3/3.5 multi-round workflow introduced by the diff, especially the transitions among run-step3-review.sh, Gate B, plan-review-continuation.sh, and design-step3-state.sh. Verify that each LOOP_STATUS branch, cap path, --approve path, and pause/resume sentinel path either re-enters Step 3 or proceeds to Step 3b exactly as intended without double-applying findings or bypassing Gate C. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifacts
archetypes.rationale: New cumulative and per-round artifact handling affects summaries, retally, skipped findings, and failure restoration.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review how accepted findings, cumulative accepted findings, rejected Gate B skips, OOS findings, and retally outputs are persisted and restored across plan-review-loop.sh, persist-retally-step3-env.sh, and render-final-summary.sh. Look for stale or duplicated artifacts, incorrect counts after main-agent adjudication or tally-error, and mismatches between the session-root files and per-round snapshots. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contracts
archetypes.rationale: Runtime helpers, SKILL.md prose, approval-gate references, and harness wiring must remain a single coherent contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the normative prose and runtime contracts for plan review and approval gates with the actual Bash helpers and harness wiring added in this diff. Focus on whether docs, SKILL.md orchestration, Makefile/relevant-checks targets, and test expectations describe one consistent lifecycle for automatic review rounds and final approval. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
